relationships.subject: TRPV1+ nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: sigma-1 agonism exacerbates pain-like responses in mice with a mild inflammatory state through the action of TRPV1 + nociceptors

relationships.subject: BD-1063
relationships.evidence_quote: The effects of sigma-1 agonists were all reversed by administration of the sigma-1 antagonist BD-1063 in wild-type mice

key_findings: Sigma-1 agonists exacerbate PGE2-induced and post-incision hyperalgesia in a neutrophil- and TRPV1+ neuron-dependent manner
Sigma-1 receptors are present in most mouse and human DRG neurons
